detected_fault: Random Blue Screens of Death (BSOD) with Memory Management-related error codes
suggested_solution: Try new RAM cards if available (new or refurbished) to rule out hardware issues.
Claim warranty support from Acer for the 8-month-old device.
Perform a clean reinstall of Windows using a bootable USB drive after addressing any hardware issues.
Download and install necessary drivers, including NitroSense and Acer Care, from Acer's website.
Consider installing a paid antivirus software (e.g., Kaspersky, McAfee, Norton) for added protection.
